name: Vietnam Promo Source Hunter
purpose: Discover, validate, canonicalize and deduplicate internet sources serving the Vietnam promo/voucher market. This project produces source inputs; it is not the mass promo/code extraction engine.

data_contract.market_scope: Entire internet ecosystem serving Vietnam, regardless of TLD
never_equate: source URL rows with unique brands

coordination.rule: Before a peer task performs overlapping source discovery, read this manifest and integration/work-allocation.json. Peer tasks should publish their own project_id, repo, capabilities and output paths before work is repartitioned.
coordination.write_policy: Do not mutate native Source Hunter state from another task unless explicitly assigned in work-allocation.json. Peer results should be produced separately and merged deterministically.
